name: RC-B10-0071/2026 – After § 5 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the brutal repression against protesters in Iran
part_text: 5c. Stresses that returning Iranians to Iran in the current circumstances of mass killing and detention is deeply immoral and in breach of international law; calls, therefore, on the Member States to temporarily suspend any forced returns to Iran while there remains a risk of persecution, arbitrary detention and application of the death penalty;
